question: Does adding real broadcast-tracking windows from the six unused SkillCorner 2019/20 TRAIN matches to the frontier CE continuation raise exposed-development feed_like_v2 spell F1 above 0.60 without regressing clean/v1 spell or any short-recall mean?

new_data.labels: provider possession group H/A silver labels; null=X; no D
new_data.grading_rule: shared multisource_eval.view: unobserved positions masked, <12 visible players -> X
new_data.provider_exclusion: treated as SkillCorner; the SkillCorner-held-out fold reuses the control fit
new_data.prior_use: processed 2026-10-25 in mtah-data; referenced by no training or evaluation code before this study

control: approved frontier joint_gru_sn_dense_spell_frontier_ensemble_v1 development replay: clean/v1/v2 spell 0.6701365499557103/0.532128306931943/0.5936187198896373 (reproduced exactly from the frontier_recovery_v1 archive before this freeze)

training.warm_start: reconstructed frontier CE stage-1024 provider-excluded checkpoints (frontier_recovery_v1)

arms.ctrl: 16 GAR / 0 SkillCorner-2020 external windows (matched fresh continuation)

training.loss: shared v2_iterative_train CE+spell+transition objective; external loss mass 0.5 split in proportion to window counts

pipelines: replace: arm CE replaces the frontier CE component
half: equal seed-wise probability mix of approved CE and arm CE
candidates.fixed: CE/calibrated/predecessor 0.5/0.375/0.125 arithmetic, seeds within phase then phases, H/A cost 3, exact predecessor decoded D mask

evaluation.aggregation: realizations within match, matches within provider, providers equally

success: a retained candidate with feed_like_v2 spell_f1 > 0.60
ranking: retained candidates by feed_like_v2 spell_f1; data effect reported as arm minus ctrl at the same snapshot and pipeline
not_allowed: additional arms, weights, costs or seeds chosen after seeing these results without a new declaration
limits: five exposed matches reused by every prior v2 study; SkillCorner 2020 cannot affect the SkillCorner fold, so any gain must come from Sportec and Metrica
